document: Northwind Labs is hiring a Product Analyst to support projects for clients such as Quarry Bio. The role is fully remote. Base pay is $120k-$140k per year, plus a signing bonus of $5,000. You need at least 5 years of experience; 7+ years is preferred. Apply by August 14, 2026.

schema.application_deadline: date YYYY-MM-DD; null if not stated
schema.city: string: work location city; null if fully remote with no city
schema.company: string: the hiring company (not a client or partner mentioned)
schema.salary_max_usd: number: upper bound of the ANNUAL base salary in USD; null if not stated
schema.salary_min_usd: number: lower bound of the ANNUAL base salary in USD; null if not stated
schema.years_experience: integer: minimum years of experience required
